newsitem.title: INDIA: India Ranbaxy 96/97 net at 1.49 bln.
newsitem.headline: India Ranbaxy 96/97 net at 1.49 bln.

text.p: Leading Indian pharmaceutical firm, Ranbaxy Laboratories Ltd., said on Thursday its net profits had increased to 1.496 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March), compared with 1.35 billion rupees last year.

The company said earnings per share on the increased year-end equity share capital of 494 million rupees, up from 444 million rupees in 1995/96, was 30.27 rupees against 30.42 rupees the previous year.
The company recorded sales of 10.657 billion rupees against 8.766 billion the previous year, with domestic sales accounting for 5.439 billion rupees and exports for 5.218 billion rupees.
"The past year saw significant growth in the domestic pharmaceutical markets as Ranbaxy employed a well-planned and aggressive strategy of acquisitions and mergers," the statement said.

"The acquisition of brands from Gufic and the Croslands merger willl significantly consolidate the company's leadership position with market share in excess of five per cent and bring into its fold a range of products," it added.
